name: 370-wedding
notes: #370 C3.a: the wedding the people organise because the Keeper showed up, built from the game's own plan (Life/MomentStagePlan.cs) and beats (View/Beats/MomentBeats.cs). A kid looks up at the glass, points (a '!' in the game), runs to tell; everyone walks over into two rows; the couple walk the aisle hand in hand and each row cheers as they pass (a wave); the vow and the blessing; hands joined and a hop; a ring dances round them (in step on purpose, B2.e); they all wave to the glass. Walks there are straight here; the game walks the paths.
